title: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Game's Trailers Reveal Switch 2 Version, Tokyo Revengers DLC Characters
content: SNK announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday that it will release its Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves fighting game for Nintendo Switch 2 digitally on October 22 and physically in January 2027.
author: ANN

title: Marvelous Announces Eternal Anima Game for Switch 2, PS5, Xbox X|S, PC
content: Marvelous announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday a new JRPG titled Eternal Anima , formerly known as Project Life is RPG . The game launches for Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam on March 4.
author: ANN

title: Ninja Scroll 4K Remaster Sets October 4, 5 and 7 North American Theatrical Release, Exclusive Still Available
content: Tickets are now on sale for the limited North American theatrical release of the new 4K remaster of Ninja Scroll , with screenings scheduled for October 4, 5 and 7, 2026 in the United States and Canada. HIDIVE and Iconic Events Releasing will present the three-day run in approximately 600 theaters.
author: Anime Corner

title: SSS-Class Revival Hunter Manhwa Announces Anime Adaptation for January 2027, Reveals First Teaser, Visual, Cast
content: The anime adaptation of SSS-Class Revival Hunter will premiere in January 2027, with a teaser visual, first trailer, main cast and staff also revealed. Crunchyroll has confirmed that it will stream the series internationally. Takeo Otsuka stars as Kim Gongja, with Satoshi Hino voicing the Sword Emperor.
author: Anime Corner

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Confirms Its Place in the Timeline & How Long It’s Been Since Korra
content: Avatar Studios is returning for a brand new TV series picking up from the events of The Legend of Korra , and those behind it all have now confirmed just how long it’s been since Korra’s time as the Avatar.
author: ComicBook

title: Webtoon 'SSS-Class Revival Hunter' Gets TV Anime in January 2027
content: Production company Hayate opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Sinnoa and Bill K 's SSS-Class Revival Hunter webtoon on Wednesday. The website also revealed the main cast, staff, teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser promotional video. The anime is scheduled to premiere in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Apothecary Diaries Series Gets New Mystery Game for Consoles, PC
content: Koei Tecmo announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday The Apothecary Diaries : The False Imperial Brother , a new game based on Hyuganatsu and Touko Shino 's The Apothecary Diaries ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) light novel series.
author: ANN
